title: I think more people experience this phenomenon but they aren't aware of it because their dreams don't recur or they don't remember it.
content: My mom and my partner both have had mallworld dreams (to the T) but they do not experience them very often, like once per year. Mine are daily or several times a week. I've seen other redditors have the dreams too, but since they arent recurring, they dont put such stock into it. There are also times that my boyfriend recalls mallworld dreams but only ever slightly, he doesn't remember most of his dreams even if he does have them. I think there are definitely more people out there who sees all of this but they can't connect it together due to the sparsely occurring memories or times they do dream.
